transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, what brought me in is my eating habits lately. After my evening class, I'll sometimes stop for food and just... keep eating. I end up having a full fast-food meal, grab candy from the vending machine, and then eat even more snacks once I get home. It’s honestly like I’m trying to make up for the whole day all at once.
During these episodes, do you feel a sense of loss of control, like you can't stop eating once you've started?

Yeah, that is exactly it. Once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But... my hands just keep reaching for more. I really can't stop until I feel embarrassed and just sick of myself.
After these episodes happen, do you do anything to try to make up for or get rid of the food you ate?

Yes, I have. A few times after those late-night eating spells, I've gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up. I just... I get scared that all that food is going to show on me, so I try to get rid of it.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are?
I'm about 5 foot 10, and... well, I haven't weighed myself in a few weeks, but last I checked I was around 170 pounds.
About how many times a week do these episodes of overeating and making yourself throw up happen?

Well, for about the past three months or so, it's usually at least one night a week. It mostly seems to happen after my evening class... I'll get home, overeat like that, and then make myself throw up afterward.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports recurrent episodes of binge eating characterized by consuming large quantities of food accompanied by a distinct sense of lack of control. These episodes are followed by recurrent inappropriate compensatory behavior in the form of self-induced vomiting driven by fear of weight gain. The symptoms have been occurring at a frequency of at least once per week for the past three months, and the patient maintains a normal body weight (BMI ~24.4), fulfilling diagnostic criteria for bulimia nervosa.
